notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: reviewed_by is null, and no hardware or sim backend was run. The package serves the card's models[0], toddlerbot/descriptions/toddlerbot_2xc/scene.xml, and names CartwheelEnv (the first ast entry symbol) as native; the other four MJX entry symbols (ClimbDownBoxEnv, ClimbUpBoxEnv, ClimbWallEnv, CrawlDownStairsEnv) and the environment's motion reference, observation, reward, domain randomization and episode logic are not exposed, and facts.md names them with file:line. MuJoCo and the JAX/MJX stack were not importable where the gate ran, so fake.py is a pure Python stand-in for the mujoco library: it parses the scene and its included robot model for the free joint, the hinge joints, the 30 actuators, the ctrlrange -10 10 (toddlerbot_2xc.xml:31) and the option time step, but it integrates placeholder joint motion and resolves no mesh, contact, equality or actuator dynamics; the sim backend was not run and no trajectory was compared with the real engine. The published timestep_ms 2.0 comes from the stand-in's placeholder library default because the scene sets no <option timestep>, not from a Fact. The 66 MB asset directory and all 47 mesh references are present in the clone, so needs_recon artifacts did not block; no asset is copied into this package. README.md:167 says the design STL files are CC BY-NC-SA while the code is MIT (README.md:165); the package only reads them from the read-only clone. Warnings: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because backends['fake'] is the package's stand-in module object (the bridge calls the mujoco API, which the upstream CartwheelEnv class does not have; a string entry would make G7 check that API against a training-environment class and fail); G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the bridge-derived inputs (ticks, action.ctrl, seed). No catalogue request: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used. gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed.
